sources.origin: English Wikipedia "Lincoln cent mintage figures" (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lincoln_cent_mintage_figures), revision 1365409408, fetched 2026-11-21 through the MediaWiki API (action=parse)

sources.note: Business strikes only: proof, pattern, restrike and bullion rows were skipped. mintage is null where the source gives no figure. Physical specs, the key-date flag and images were not filled in.

rules-note: Business strikes only: proofs and patterns are skipped, and collector-only strikes (Special Mint Set, Satin, Enhanced and plain Uncirculated rows) are dropped. Mint marks are as on the coin: a Mint cell in parentheses means the coin has no mark (null). Comments such as 'Doubled-Die varieties have been found' or 'Small and Large date varieties' have no separate row or figure and add no variety. Mintages come only from the saved source. The four 2009 designs are varieties (Birthplace, Formative Years, Professional Life, Presidency) for no mark and D, each with its design table's business-strike figure. The bronze Satin uncirculated strikes are collector-only and excluded.
name: Lincoln Bicentennial Cent
